title: Pokemon Temporal Forces Keldeo 044/162 Reverse Holo.
categoryName: Toys & Hobbies:Collectible Card Games:CCG Individual Cards
descriptionText: This is a Pokémon TCG card featuring Keldeo from the Scarlet & Violet - Temporal Forces set in English. The card is a Reverse Holo version with card number 044/162. It is a standard size card, part of the CCG Individual Cards category.
